# Supplementary material {.unnumbered}

This supplementary material provides model specifications, sampling and species summaries, model diagnostics, posterior predictive checks, and residual temporal diagnostics supporting the main-text analysis of bat activity in the northern Sierra Nevada. Intermediate model-development objects that do not contribute directly to interpretation are retained in the analysis repository rather than reproduced here.



# Supplementary tables

## Table S1. Final model specifications


::: {#tbl-s1-model-definitions .cell tbl-cap='Final Bayesian generalized additive models used to estimate aggregate and frequency-group bat activity. All models used a negative-binomial response distribution with a log link and site-specific seasonal phenology represented by penalized factor-smooth interactions where applicable.'}
::: {.cell-output-display}

|:----------------------------|:-----------------------|:----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|:----------------------|-----------:|
|Aggregate seasonal           |Aggregate activity      |n ~ s(doy) + s(doy, Site, bs = "fs")                                                     |negbinomial (log link) |        1056|
|Aggregate environmental      |Aggregate activity      |n ~ s(doy) + s(doy, Site, bs = "fs") + s(scale_avetemp) + s(scale_averh) +      s(Lunar) |negbinomial (log link) |        1056|
|Low-frequency environmental  |Low-frequency activity  |n ~ s(doy) + s(doy, Site, bs = "fs") + s(scale_avetemp) + s(scale_averh) +      s(Lunar) |negbinomial (log link) |        1056|

# Additional model assessment

Routine trace plots are not reproduced because the tabulated sampling diagnostics document convergence and effective sample sizes for the final models. The graphical diagnostics above focus on model adequacy relevant to the biological estimands: posterior predictive fit, among-site predictive performance, and remaining short-lag temporal dependence.
